**Key discriminating features against alternatives:**
- The **black sclerotia** rule out Southern Blight (which produces tan/brown mustard-seed sclerotia)
- The cottony white mycelium with developing black sclerotia is the hallmark of *Sclerotinia sclerotiorum*
